caption: The drawing depicts a seascape featuring two sailing ships with brownish-pink sails and hulls navigating through stylized, wavy blue and white water. The larger ship is positioned in the foreground on the left side, with tattered sails and rigging, while the smaller ship is further back toward the center. To the right of the ships, there is a tall lighthouse rendered in shades of pink and light brown, with arched windows and a domed top, set on a rocky outcrop. The left side of the composition shows a dark brown rock formation with light pink and darker brown highlights, and hints of white water crashing at the base. The background is filled with a solid light blue sky, scattered with several white birds in flight. The words "Sandy Hook" are written in capital letters in the sky area, near the top right. The entire scene is framed by a cream-colored margin, with the illustrated area forming a horizontal rectangle.
title: Bandbox
